import numpy as np, json
R=np.load('R.npy'); S=json.load(open('S.json'))
T=R.shape[0]; h=T//2
def sr(x): return x.mean()/x.std()*np.sqrt(252)
H=[i for i,s in enumerate(S) if s.startswith('hold')]
slow=[i for i,s in enumerate(S) if s.endswith('_50_200') or (s.startswith('tsmom') and (s.endswith('_252') or s.endswith('_126')))]
for a,b in [((0,h),(h,T)),((h,T),(0,h))]:
    A=R[a[0]:a[1]]; B=R[b[0]:b[1]]
    s=np.array([sr(A[:,i]) for i in H])
    w=s/R[a[0]:a[1],H].std(0); w=w/np.abs(w).sum()  # signed by in-sample SR
    pB=B[:,H]@w; pA=A[:,H]@w
    print('hold tilt IS %.2f OOS %.2f'%(sr(pA),sr(pB)))
    order=np.argsort(s); top=[H[k] for k in order[-10:]]; bot=[H[k] for k in order[:10]]
    p=B[:,top].mean(1)-B[:,bot].mean(1); print('top10-bot10 OOS %.2f'%sr(p))
    st=B[:,slow].mean(1); print('slow OOS %.2f'%sr(st), 'corr', np.corrcoef(st,pB)[0,1])
    for k in [0.3,0.5]:
        c=(1-k)*st/st.std()+k*pB/pB.std(); print(' combo',k,'%.2f'%sr(c))
EOF
